name: An early retiree living on capital, at the minimum base
workings: No pension yet, so voluntary GKV whatever retirementHealthInsurance says

Health (14.0% + 2.9%) × 15,820 = 2,673.58; care 4.2% × 15,820 = 664.44; all in prepare, assess adds nothing
